Class WallManager

java.lang.Object
moldsim.model.WallManager
public class WallManager extends Object
Manages a collection of wall contexts and provides navigation between them.

This class allows switching between multiple walls in the simulation, maintaining a current active wall index and providing access to adjacent walls.
